workouts.title: TEAMWOD
workouts.description:
For time:
9 rounds of:
3 Burpee Box Jumps, 24/20 in
6 Chest-to-bar Pull-ups
9 Power Cleans, 40/30 kg
Row, 1200/900 m
-- then --
Rest 3 mins
-- then --
6 rounds of:
4 Burpee Box Jumps, 24/20 in
8 Chest-to-bar Pull-ups
12 Power Cleans, 40/30 kg
Row, 1500/1200 m
-- then --
Rest 3 mins
-- then --
3 rounds of:
6 Burpee Box Jumps, 24/20 in
12 Chest-to-bar Pull-ups
15 Power Cleans, 40/30 kg
Row, 1800/1500 m

workouts.title: Strength Cycle - Deadlift
workouts.description:
Deadlift 1x10 at 15% 1RM
Deadlift 1x8 at 55% 1RM
Deadlift 1x5 at 70% 1RM
Deadlift 1x3 at 83% 1RM
Deadlift 1x3 at 88% 1RM
Deadlift 1x1+ at 93% 1RM

Rest 3 mins between sets.

workouts.title: "Launch Pad"
workouts.description:
For total rounds and reps:
AMRAP in 2 mins of:
3 Hang Power Cleans, 45/30 kg
3 Burpee Box Jumps, 24/20 in
-- then --
Rest 1 min
-- then --
AMRAP in 3 mins of:
3 Hang Power Cleans, 45/30 kg
3 Burpee Box Jumps, 24/20 in
-- then --
Rest 1 min
-- then --
AMRAP in 4 mins of:
3 Hang Power Cleans, 45/30 kg
3 Burpee Box Jumps, 24/20 in

For each AMRAP, restart from 0.
